notes: copilot mcp add (1.0.104) writes tools ["*"], type local, command, args, env or tools, type http, url, headers, with a final newline (V, recorded). Schema (bundled api.schema.json): stdio {command, args, cwd, env, type stdio|local}, remote {url, type http|sse, headers, oauth*}, plus tools, excludeTools, timeout ms, deferTools, displayName (V). A value that starts with $ is read as a reference to an environment variable (V for the changelog entry, github.com/github/copilot-cli changelog.md#L3447; I that it holds at 1.0.104; not probed, since `copilot mcp list` starts no server). So tk writes $VAR as a whole value only and refuses a header such as Bearer ${VAR} for Copilot. COPILOT_HOME or --config-dir replaces ~/.copilot (V, cli-main.js). Enable/disable is a persisted list, not a key. It also reads .mcp.json and .github/mcp.json in a workspace.
